intro.text: A place in eastern Roshar, a region often thought of as a crumbling, empty wasteland, though some Alethi mapmakers know of it.
A place on Roshar's far eastern coast, a region often thought of as an empty wasteland, though some Alethi mapmakers know of it.

description.text: East of the Unclaimed Hills, it sits on a sea that opens onto the Ocean of Origins, within what was once the Silver Kingdom of Natanatan. New Natanan, a city-state, is the nearest population center.
